statement: TSMC's advanced-packaging (CoWoS) is sold out through 2027 with lead times of 52-78 weeks and bookings extending into 2027, even as CoWoS capacity ramps from ~75,000 wafers/month at end-2025 toward ~125,000-130,000 by end-2026; TSMC raised 2026 capex to $60-64 billion (from $52-56 billion), partly for CoWoS expansion.
why: AI-GPU demand for CoWoS packaging is outrunning even TSMC's aggressive capacity ramp; the CEO says it will struggle to meet US customer demand for years, keeping advanced packaging, the key AI-GPU bottleneck, sold out.

impact.mechanism: CoWoS being sold out through 2027 with 52-78-week lead times caps how many AI GPUs can be packaged and shipped, a hard supply bottleneck for merchant GPUs even as capacity expands.

evidence.excerpt: CoWoS advanced-packaging lead times cited at 52-78 weeks with bookings extending into 2027 and TSMC's advanced-packaging backend sold out through 2027

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of TSMC's Q2 2026 earnings; packaging lead-time and capacity figures from same-week trade coverage.
